name: Allo
description: Allo lets agents read call transcripts and SMS, look up and update contacts, and draft text messages in the signed-in workspace. Each user signs in to their own Allo account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which calls did I miss today, and what did the callers want?
Summarize my last call with this customer.
Update the contact for Tom Becker with his new company name.

apps.name: Allo
apps.description: Call, SMS, and contact tools, over Allo's MCP server with browser sign-in.
